# Contributing to tevd-portal

The rules for agents and people, including the PR flow, are in `AGENTS.md`. This file covers the one rule that applies to text leaving the
working tree.

## No AI attribution

The work in this repository is the maintainer's, whatever tools helped write it. Commits, PR
titles and PR bodies carry none of:

- a `Co-Authored-By:` trailer naming an AI tool or vendor
- a "Generated with …" or "Generated by …" line naming an AI tool
- an AI tool's noreply address or product link

Coding assistants add these by default. Turn the default off where the tool allows it, and remove
the lines where it does not.

Naming a tool in ordinary prose is fine ("update CLAUDE.md", "remove the Copilot config").

**Enforced by** the `Attribution` workflow (`.github/workflows/attribution.yml`), which runs
`scripts/check-ai-attribution.js` over the PR's commits, title and body. It checks only the PR's
own commits; history from before the rule stays as it is.

Run it locally before pushing:

```bash
npm run check:attribution -- origin/main..HEAD
```

A failing commit: reword it (`git commit --amend`, or an interactive rebase for older commits on an
unpushed branch). A failing PR title or body: edit it; the check re-runs on edit.
